verdict.rationale: Official sources list install paths for pip, uv, Docker, and Kubernetes (kubectl, kustomize, helm), plus bare metal, and a quick-start command pulls and runs the image. That covers the Docker and Kubernetes/Helm targets. Nothing in the evidence shows dedicated, maintained guides for Docker Compose, a small VPS, or Raspberry Pi/ARM. missing for 10: per-target maintained guides, explicit Docker Compose guide, small-VPS guide, Raspberry Pi/ARM guide, independent corroboration of the install paths.
